title: Private Status Unlikely
objective: Emit a portable unlikely-branch hint only for checked-private native-call status propagation, preserving exact ABI and fallback semantics, with structural and runtime tests

oracles: Checked-private compiler structural and runtime witnesses plus frozen Stage G replay

handoff.summary: Checked-private status propagation now carries a portable unlikely hint while public and unproved calls remain unchanged. Frozen Stage G replay preserved all 7,081 active outputs and nine malformed cases. Two independent seven-pair processes were favorable in all 14 pairs: pooled geometric means improved from 2.160231519 ms to 2.112938745 ms per catalog (ratio 0.978107544, a 2.19% improvement); object text fell 473 bytes and ELF text fell 424 bytes. The change also fixes direct-result ABI validation so provenance comments containing words such as status or fail cannot be mistaken for executable C.
risks: The likelihood annotation is intentionally restricted to status propagation where both caller and callee are authenticated checked-region private variants; broad cold-label experiments were substantially slower and must not be generalized from this result.

The full pnpm test:native correctness run reached 73 passes and then reported only five pre-existing stale IR-version assertions (expected 45, compiler baseline is 46), the same unrelated failures documented by adjacent compiler lanes. The focused native compiler suite, architecture checks, strict checks, and complete build passed.
next_steps: Review and integrate this positive compiler change before composing further Stage I experiments.
Keep the guarded-fallible division mechanism disabled for this catalog until a code-shape strategy removes its measured 0.29% slowdown and 3.2 KB ELF growth.
